s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis's benchmark analysis finds open-source models now take half as long to catch up to the first closed-source model of each era, with the catch-up falling from 8.5 months in Era 2 to 4.8 months in Era 3.

The article frames the shrinking gap as a FUD/risk to frontier-lab margins but concludes it is less bearish on frontier models than the trend might suggest, partly because benchmarks poorly proxy real productized work.
